title: Notifications Account Available policy

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Account Available notifications must fire only when an inactive fallback account becomes useful again after previously being unavailable.
Account Available notifications must not announce first-saved, only-saved, already-active, barely usable, or non-fallback accounts.
After Account Available is delivered for a fallback account, repeated availability events for that account must be suppressed until CodexPill observes that account become active.

targetSurface: CodexPill notification policy and fake notification workflow delivery

nonClaims: Does not exercise live macOS notification delivery.
Does not prove native notification UI rendering or user clicks.
